name: CometChat
description: CometChat is a robust communication platform that enables seamless integration of chat, voice, and video functionalities into your applications. Ideal for enhancing user engagement and interaction, CometChat supports a wide range of features including real-time messaging, group chats, and multimedia sharing.

events.d: Runs when a new message is sent in your CometChat app, optionally in a chosen chat.
Runs when a user joins or is added to a chosen CometChat group.
Add a new chat user with a display name, avatar, and optional profile details.
Block one or more users so the chosen user can no longer message or interact with them.
Add one or more people to a user's friends list and optionally add the friend chat to the user's conversations.
Create a chat group with a name, visibility, tags, and members.
Stop a user from joining or sending messages in the selected group.
Reactivate one or more users so they can sign in and use your CometChat app again.
Update a user's profile details like name, avatar, tags, contact number, and status message.
Update a CometChat group's name, type, icon, description, owner, tags or metadata.
Send a text message to a selected user or group.
Post a text reply inside an existing message thread so the conversation continues in that thread.
Delete a CometChat user, optionally permanently with all their messages.
Get a CometChat user's profile by user ID.
List or search CometChat users with status, role, tag and date filters.
Create a login auth token for a CometChat user.
Get a CometChat group's details by group ID.
List or search CometChat groups with type, tag, size and date filters.
Add users to a CometChat group as participants, moderators or admins.
Delete a CometChat group by group ID.
Remove (kick) a member from a CometChat group.
List the members of a CometChat group with status and scope filters.
List or search CometChat messages by conversation, sender, type and date.
Delete a CometChat message, optionally permanently.
Runs when a new user is created in your CometChat app.
Runs when a new group is created in your CometChat app.
